_comment: Accepted systematic diffs between the Next.js site and the WordPress recreation. Field → 'any' (every route) or an array of routes. Each entry must be explainable in docs/PARITY.md.
notes: ogSiteName: WordPress emits og:site_name on every page; Next's page-level openGraph objects drop the layout's siteName on most routes. Emitting it everywhere is deliberate (better OG completeness).

ogImage on /dr-basmajian/ and the your-surgery tree: Next derives it from public/ asset paths (e.g. /dr-picture.jpg, /images/your-surgery/*.webp); in WordPress those assets live at theme/uploads URLs. Post featured-image OG URLs are identical (original upload paths preserved).

Canonical/og:url trailing slashes are normalized before comparison: Next canonicals are slashless, WordPress canonical form has trailing slashes. Both resolve identically (the WP rewrite layer 301s slashless to slashed; Next did the inverse).
